method: Read-only post-run parsing of skill public-api rows and public evidence retained in harness frames/events. No simulator, model, hidden checker, private world snapshot, or geometry reconstruction used.

definitions.mask_check: For every final blocked_endpoints row, link evidence_ref to its public_call_start and link command_id to exactly one public move receipt. Confirm actor, XYZ, args, error message, unchanged before/after public XYZ, and absence of a later same-actor same-XYZ move request in this recorded run.
definitions.new_unique_failure: Difference from same-task flight_state_v3 failure-signature set: endpoint=(kind,actor,XYZ); path=(kind,actor,public start XYZ,endpoint XYZ). These are distinct recorded signatures, not statistically independent samples.
definitions.cross_actor_endpoint_event: Count each endpoint-conflict request once if at least one earlier endpoint-conflict request in this same task/run has the exact same requested XYZ and a different actor. Prior events are explicitly linked; same-actor repetitions and all path conflicts are excluded.
definitions.cross_actor_endpoint_group: One exact XYZ with endpoint-conflict receipts from at least two actors in the same task/run. Event count and group count are reported separately.
definitions.geometry_visibility: A name-match search in earlier skill nearby obstacle records only; absence means no such public record was found, not that geometry does not exist. Names are not converted to obstacle IDs or shapes.

limitations: Fixed recorded executions, not a new experiment or counterfactual success estimate.
Whole-task success and total obstacle errors remain separate from absence of same-actor repeated endpoint requests.

The second 24ac replacement follows an earlier trajectory divergence: its prior mask and absence of the old endpoint are verified, but logs alone do not isolate the contribution of all changed coverage scores to the alternative selected.
Negative point evidence is scoped to the tested plan/epoch and fixed altitude; transfer across actors or dynamic obstacle changes needs a separate contract.
